{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1658,"var":"data_copy","code":"memcpy(data_copy, data, length);","note":"The bytes are copied into a mutable buffer so the parser can temporarily NUL-terminate header fields."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1679,"var":"request","code":"read_request_finalizer(length, sizeof(data_copy), &request, 1)","note":"Only inputs that look like a complete request continue into parse_http_request, so the crafted header block is actually parsed."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1208,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"The request line is skipped and parsing advances to the header section."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":536,"var":"next_hdr","code":"next_hdr = memchr(next_chr, '\\r', (size_t)(buffer_end - p));","note":"The parser scans attacker-controlled header lines one by one until it finds the CR that ends each line."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":553,"var":"header_start[n_headers++]","code":"header_start[n_headers++] = next_chr; header_start[n_headers++] = next_hdr;","note":"Each header line consumes two slots in the fixed header_start array before any bounds check runs."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":558,"var":"n_headers","code":"if (n_headers > N_HEADER_START || p >= buffer_end) {","note":"The bounds check is too late: once n_headers reaches 64, the previous writes have already stepped past the end of the 64-entry array."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_headers","line":553,"var":"memory after header_start","code":"header_start[n_headers++] = next_chr; header_start[n_headers++] = next_hdr;","note":"Memory-safety sink: an out-of-bounds write into adjacent static storage, consistent with the reported global-buffer-overflow WRITE 8 in parse_headers."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]')
print(p)
